statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and exertional dyspnea
There is concern for underlying arrhythmia
The patient has a history of sick sinus syndrome
The patient has a history of supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of atrial fibrillation
The service is intended to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances and guide further management
The service is bundled into another covered procedure and is not separately payable
